basis: written QUV state machine and theorem assumptions only

families.expectation: zero conflicting accepts with every correct reply present
families.name: sound_concurrent_opposition

families.expectation: zero liveness failures for one valid candidate despite Byzantine silence
families.name: sound_singleton_progress

families.expectation: zero failures whenever complete end-to-end time plus clock-error bound is within delta_rt
families.name: sound_deadline_edges_and_skew

families.expectation: no reply is exposed before durable state and no restart loses exposed state
families.name: sound_write_reply_crash_order

families.expectation: all stale and cross-context replies are rejected on every mismatch
families.name: sound_exact_reply_binding

families.expectation: one live old-root result is durably installed before new-root activation
families.name: sound_live_reconfiguration

families.expectation: a conflict in one domain neither blocks nor authorizes another domain
families.name: sound_unrelated_domain_isolation

families.expectation: at most one physical mutation across every modeled crash point
families.name: sound_t10_stable_key

families.expectation: must expose safety and singleton-liveness failures
minimized_traces: the sole correct member's reply is absent from both verifier inputs
Byzantine B returns singleton {X} to EX and singleton {Y} to EY
EX accepts X and EY accepts Y
the sole correct reply is absent and all Byzantine members omit
the only valid candidate S has no admitted snapshot
singleton progress fails
families.name: mutation_absent_correct_reply

families.expectation: must expose safety and liveness failures when response delivery is outside delta_rt
minimized_traces: requests X and Y reach the correct member within the one-way bound
both correct responses arrive after each verifier's deadline
selective Byzantine singleton replies make both X and Y accept
request S is timely but the correct response is late
Byzantine members omit
S does not complete by delta_rt
families.name: mutation_one_way_only_timing

families.expectation: must expose authorization outside the rooted decision interval
minimized_traces: delta_rt=4; verifier reaches tick 4 with no eligible reply
a valid singleton reply is recorded at tick 5
late-inclusive finish accepts instead of returning NoValidReplies
families.name: mutation_accept_reply_after_deadline

families.expectation: must expose conflicting accepts after a crash
minimized_traces: correct member exposes signed singleton {X} before durable write; EX accepts X
member crashes and loses X
member durably records Y, replies singleton {Y}; EY accepts Y
families.name: mutation_reply_before_durable

families.expectation: must expose conflicting accepts after durable-state rollback
minimized_traces: correct member durably records X and EX accepts X
storage and rollback anchor are restored to the pre-X image
member records Y as singleton and EY accepts Y
families.name: mutation_rollback

families.expectation: must expose rollback when an anchor authenticates only the prior head
minimized_traces: anchor authenticates generation g and head H after X was exposed and accepted
attacker writes an unauthenticated state at g+1 with previous_head=H but erases X
restart blesses g+1, then a singleton Y reply makes EY accept Y
families.name: mutation_unauthenticated_one_generation_recovery

families.expectation: must expose conflicting accepts when snapshot/read is not one atomic durable transition
minimized_traces: concurrent X and Y writes race without one slot linearization
EX receives singleton snapshot {X}; EY receives singleton snapshot {Y}
both executors accept
families.name: mutation_split_write_read_atomicity

families.expectation: must expose cross-domain replay acceptance
minimized_traces: correct member signs singleton X in context A and singleton Y in context B differing in domain
verifier omits domain from exact reply/candidate validation
both replies are reinterpreted for one logical conflict slot; X and Y both accept
families.name: mutation_missing_domain_binding

families.expectation: must expose cross-slot replay acceptance
minimized_traces: correct member signs singleton X in context A and singleton Y in context B differing in slot
verifier omits slot from exact reply/candidate validation
both replies are reinterpreted for one logical conflict slot; X and Y both accept
families.name: mutation_missing_slot_binding

families.expectation: must expose cross-root replay acceptance
minimized_traces: correct member signs singleton X in context A and singleton Y in context B differing in root
verifier omits root from exact reply/candidate validation
both replies are reinterpreted for one logical conflict slot; X and Y both accept
families.name: mutation_missing_root_binding

families.expectation: must expose cross-configuration replay acceptance
minimized_traces: correct member signs singleton X in context A and singleton Y in context B differing in configuration
verifier omits configuration from exact reply/candidate validation
both replies are reinterpreted for one logical conflict slot; X and Y both accept
families.name: mutation_missing_configuration_binding

families.expectation: must expose cross-candidate replay acceptance
minimized_traces: correct member signs singleton X in context A and singleton Y in context B differing in candidate
verifier omits candidate from exact reply/candidate validation
both replies are reinterpreted for one logical conflict slot; X and Y both accept
families.name: mutation_missing_candidate_binding

families.expectation: must expose a fork when two predecessors create independent stores
minimized_traces: same configuration/domain/slot: owner signs X with predecessor PX and Y with predecessor PY
correct member indexes conflict state by predecessor and no executor checks the durable expected head
the PX and PY stores each return a singleton; EX accepts X and EY accepts Y
families.name: mutation_predecessor_is_storage_key_without_expected_head_check

families.expectation: must expose a conflicting authorization under a different live fault/timing assignment
minimized_traces: EX completes live QUV for X and saves a finite transcript
later EY treats copied bytes from another context/fault assignment as live authority
EY externalizes Y without observing the current correct state; X and Y are authorized
families.name: mutation_cached_or_portable_acceptance

families.expectation: must expose conflicting mutation candidates
minimized_traces: executor EX performs fresh QUV and admits X
executor EY consumes a receipt/operator assertion instead of its own operation
EY admits Y; two conflicting mutation candidates exist before T10
families.name: mutation_skipped_executor_side_quv

families.expectation: must expose conflicting activation when live old-root verification is skipped
minimized_traces: new configuration receives two copied handoff artifacts H0 and H1
old authority is unreachable, so no successor performs live old-root QUV
different successors activate conflicting roots
old configuration has expired before every correct successor completes live verification
activation correctly cannot proceed
handoff liveness fails; bytes cannot repair it
families.name: mutation_stale_membership_handoff

families.expectation: must expose cross-domain blocking or authorization
minimized_traces: D1 records conflicting X,Y in an unscoped member log
D2's sole valid S reads D1's conflict
D2 singleton progress is blocked
D1 singleton reply is accepted as D2 authority because domain is unscoped
cross-domain bytes become authorizing
families.name: mutation_unscoped_domain_state

families.expectation: must expose Q-A9/singleton-liveness loss once retained state exceeds the qualified envelope
minimized_traces: a Byzantine rooted member serially submits valid self-signed candidates at fresh slots
the grow-only whole-store rewrite crosses the qualified latency/byte envelope
a later correct singleton request in an unrelated domain cannot durably process by delta_rt
families.name: mutation_persistent_store_growth_without_lifetime_quota

families.expectation: must expose execution claimed after its committed protocol-height fence
minimized_traces: persist Authorized while height is within the manifest fence, then abort before claim
advance beyond maximum height and retry; receipt existence skips the only fence check
fresh QUV succeeds and Claimed is persisted after the manifest expired
families.name: mutation_cached_authorized_receipt_skips_live_fence

families.expectation: must expose a durable claim after process-local continuation expiry
minimized_traces: consume the online token one tick before its absolute continuation deadline
discard the deadline, then spend two ticks persisting its audit receipt
Claimed is persisted one tick after expiry because the claim transition has no clock check
families.name: mutation_continuation_checked_only_before_claim

families.expectation: must expose unrelated-domain starvation before terminal-state rejection
minimized_traces: replay a valid candidate for an already Executed receipt
run a complete delta_rt QUV while the sole global verifier slot is occupied
reject WrongState only afterward; an unrelated singleton operation cannot start
families.name: mutation_terminal_receipt_replay_holds_global_verifier

families.expectation: must expose permanent singleton-progress loss without operation retirement
minimized_traces: a configured Byzantine recipient never ACKs distinct nonce-bearing QUV requests
completed and aborted operations do not retire its durable records; the finite queue fills
the next operation aborts on that recipient before delivery to the sole correct member
families.name: mutation_silent_recipient_fills_quv_outbox

families.expectation: must expose loss of the sole correct reply after crash/reconnect replay
minimized_traces: an old correct-member reply is first after a new operation begins and consumes its account lane
transport ACKs it before the application rejects its stale nonce
the current reply is duplicate-dropped and ACK-deleted; no correct reply reaches the verifier
families.name: mutation_stale_record_consumes_current_member_lane

families.expectation: must expose authorization when durable receipt bytes replace committed admission
minimized_traces: an effect ID E has committed manifest M, but ordinary storage is replaced with a canonical self-consistent Authorized receipt for unadmitted M' under E's filename
receipt validation recomputes only unkeyed hashes; the executor skips committed authorization because E exists and derives its QUV requirement from M'
a fresh valid QUV result for M' invokes the external resource with M' even though Agentgres admitted only M
families.name: mutation_unkeyed_consequence_receipt_substitutes_unadmitted_manifest

families.expectation: must expose duplicate physical mutation after ambiguous crash
minimized_traces: external call mutates resource before a durable InFlight/claim record
executor crashes before recording the response
restart blindly calls again; physical mutation count becomes two
families.name: mutation_t10_call_before_claim
